Greetings traveler, my name is Sean (a.k.a. **terps**). I write here to learn out loud, mostly machine learning and deep learning, with side trips into the meta-skills that actually move the needle: decision-making, problem framing, and how to learn fast.

If something here is useful, wrong, or sparks an idea, reach me at [admin@terpsfi.xyz](mailto:admin@terpsfi.xyz) or [@terpsfi](https://x.com/terpsfi).

### What I'm spending time on

Right now my hands-on hours go to two places: model distillation, and agent RL / agentic workflows. In the background I'm grinding [Math Academy](https://mathacademy.com/) daily so the calculus and linear algebra under all of this stops being a hand-wave.

### Why this blog exists

The fastest way I know to find the holes in my understanding is to try and explain a thing simply. So this is the public notebook. Half tutorial, half journal, mostly an excuse to keep showing up.
